channel.title: Aseem Bhandari — Knowledge Hub
channel.description: Notes on manufacturing, process engineering, statistical process control, and building data systems that engineers and operators actually use.

item.title: Why we built our own MES — and shipped it to two factories
item.description: The build-vs-buy call behind an in-house manufacturing execution system — and why the hard parts were bilingual launch gates and floor trust, not code.

item.title: The pilot build is a question, not a milestone
item.description: A first pilot that only proves "we can build one" wastes most of its value. Treating the pilot as an experiment that answers whether the process is ready to scale.

item.title: Reading a yield signal: from noise to a ranked cause list
item.description: "Yield dropped to 84%" is an alarm, not information. How to stratify, bound, and reproduce a yield loss until it becomes a short list of things you can actually fix.

item.title: Building an SPC system operators actually use
item.description: Control charts only work if the line trusts them. Notes on standing up statistical process control at Infinitum — and the data plumbing underneath it.
